series.title: Foodberg Global Food Composite (fixed-weight)
series.description: Foodberg's own fixed-weight average of the five FAO sub-indices (meat 0.348, cereals 0.272, dairy 0.173, oils 0.135, sugar 0.072; weights renormalized over available components when at least four are present). A Foodberg construction: it is NOT the FAO Food Price Index and carries no FAO authorship.

source.name: Derived from FAO Food Price Index sub-indices
source.license: CC BY 4.0 (FAO source data); composite construction (c) Foodberg

construction.method: Weighted average of fpi_meat, fpi_cereals, fpi_dairy, fpi_oils, fpi_sugar with fixed FAO-derived weights; computed for every month with >=4 of 5 components; weights renormalized over present components; rounded to 2 decimals.

quality.notes: FAO's actual headline index (fao_fpi_overall) is a chained trade-weighted index and cannot be reproduced by a fixed-weight average; this series exists precisely to make that difference inspectable.

series.title: Foodberg US Food Price Composite (BLS CPI components)

BLS publishes no such index.

source.name: Derived from BLS CPI-U (NSA) food components
source.license: Public domain (BLS source data); composite construction (c) Foodberg

construction.method: Weighted average of CUUR0000SAF112, CUUR0000SAF111, CUUR0000SAF113, CUUR0000SEFV, CUUR0000SEFJ with fixed approximate expenditure-share weights; computed for every month with >=3 of 5 components; weights renormalized; rounded to 2 decimals.

quality.notes: A Foodberg construction; must never be labelled a BLS index.
